title: Fall 2025 undergraduate admission requirements
clean_text: The Fall 2025 prospectus lists SSC and HSC or equivalent requirements, alternative combined results criteria, O/A-level and diploma-holder routes. It describes an undergraduate MCQ admission test and separates the written-test rules for LLB and B.Pharm. CSE, EEE and Textile applicants need Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics at HSC or equivalent. B.Pharm and Architecture have separate subject and result requirements.

title: Online admission application and supporting documents
clean_text: The official application portal collects academic history, provides an attachment section, and has a review step before submission. Its attachment section lists student photograph and signature, guardian signature, SSC and HSC certificates or transcripts, student NID or birth certificate, and guardian NID. Check the official portal for the applicable intake and any alternative qualifications. Submit personal documents through the official portal only.

title: Fall 2025 scholarships and tuition waivers
clean_text: The Fall 2025 SEU prospectus describes merit scholarships, awards based on semester results, and categories for siblings or spouses, eligible athletes or other exceptional talent, freedom-fighter children, certain female or ethnic-group applicants, and some graduate applicants. Eligibility and continuation depend on the category, program and documented results. The prospectus says students cannot hold multiple waiver types at the same time. These are Fall 2025 rules. Confirm eligibility and availability for your intake with Admissions.
guidance_gap: I could not verify which scholarship categories are available for a newer intake.

title: Course registration and advising in SEU UMS
clean_text: The public SEU status directory lists Preregistration, Course Advising, Advising Table, and Registered Courses as separate UMS functions. Use the official UMS and check Registered Courses to confirm which courses appear there. The public directory does not specify the exact screen sequence or a registration deadline. Ask your program office or academic adviser for the current registration process.

title: Incomplete advising in SEU UMS
clean_text: SEU's public UMS directory distinguishes Course Advising, the Advising Table and Registered Courses. Compare the Advising Table with Registered Courses and contact your program office or academic adviser to resolve missing entries.
guidance_gap: The public documentation does not establish what happens when advising is incomplete for a particular term.

title: Midterm and final examination admit cards
clean_text: Section 5.21 of SEU's Student Code of Conduct requires students to bring their admit card to midterm and semester-final examinations and show it to the invigilator. Section 5.22 prohibits unfair means. Check the current examination notice for the procedure and your exam schedule.

title: SEU transcript grading and CGPA calculation
clean_text: The Office of the Controller of Examinations explains that CGPA is calculated by dividing total grade points by attempted credits. Course grade points are the grade value multiplied by course credits. It says accepted transfer or waived credits count toward the degree and are excluded from CGPA, and that the better grade is used for improvement.

title: Revised Fall 2023 academic calendar (except Pharmacy and Law)
clean_text: The Registrar's notice dated 4 December 2023 revised the Fall 2023 academic calendar for programs other than Pharmacy and Law. It revised the final installment, finals, grade submission and announcement dates. This is an archived Fall 2023 notice.

clean_text: SEU reported that the Department of Career and Professional Development Services (CPDS) held a higher-study workshop at the Tejgaon campus on 6 June 2024. It covered recommendation letters, statements of purpose and communicating with professors. This was a past event.

title: SEU library borrowing limits
clean_text: The official library policy lists a limit of two books for registered students and a ten-day loan period. It permits one renewal if nobody has placed a hold. Some reference, dictionary and rare-book holdings are restricted to the reading room.

title: SEU degree offerings in the Fall 2025 prospectus
clean_text: The prospectus lists undergraduate offerings in CSE, EEE, Textile Engineering, Architecture, Pharmacy, Business Administration, Law, English, Economics and Bangla. Graduate listings include MBA variants, EMBA, LLM, MA in English and Bangla and MDS. Check the admission portal for the offerings in the intake you are applying to.

title: SEU library orientation for Textile Engineering
clean_text: The SEU library catalog reported a library orientation for the Department of Textile Engineering on 1 November 2026. This is a past event rather than a general academic-calendar or registration notice.

title: Department of Bangla faculty and curriculum directory
clean_text: The SEU Department of Bangla directory separates faculty, officers and staff, and adjunct faculty. Its curriculum navigation links the BA in Bangla and MA in Bangla. Use the university directory to confirm current contacts and see the relevant curriculum.

title: EEE career and industry seminar
clean_text: SEU's bulletin reports that the EEE Department and Southeast EEE Club ran a career and industry seminar on 17 September 2025. It covered engineering industry pathways and included demonstrations of SCADA, BMS and IIoT. This is a historical event and does not publish a forwarding-letter procedure.

title: Central Library location and published service hours
clean_text: The Central Library directory lists room 812 on the eighth floor of the Tejgaon campus. Its published service hours are 9 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday through Thursday and 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Friday and Saturday. Check the directory for changes before visiting.

title: CSE library orientation in Fall 2026
clean_text: The official library catalog reported a Computer Science and Engineering library orientation on 15 November 2026. This is a past event and does not specify a future orientation or registration date.

title: Student identification for campus and facilities
clean_text: Sections 2.2 and 2.3 of the Student Code of Conduct say students must wear their own university identification card while on campus, including when using facilities, and show it when requested by university staff or security.

title: BBA concentrations listed for Fall 2025
clean_text: The Fall 2025 prospectus lists BBA concentrations in accounting, finance, human resource management, international business, bank management, management information systems, marketing, supply chain management, and tourism and hospitality management. Confirm availability for your intake with Southeast Business School.
